info.name: Github MR color customizer
info.description: Customize MR items to easily determine the status of each MR
info.additionalInfo:
Visual PR Status for GitHub

This lightweight extension enhances the GitHub pull request list by adding clear, color-coded status badges, making it easier to see the state of each PR without reading the fine print.

Perfect for developers and teams who want a more visual and efficient workflow.

Features:

At-a-Glance Overview: Instantly identify the status of every pull request on the page.
Clear Color Coding: Different colors and styles distinguish between states.

Custom Statuses:

? Approved: Solid green for PRs with 2+ approvals, ready to merge.
? Partially Approved: A distinct yellow/green striped badge for PRs with 1 approval.
? Changes Requested: A prominent red badge for PRs that need revisions.
? Review Required: An orange badge for new PRs awaiting review.
